q: Fubini's theorem allows swapping the order of integration when:
opts: The function is measurable and either non-negative or integrable on the product space
exp: Fubini: for non-negative measurable f (Tonelli) or integrable f, ∫∫f dμdν = ∫∫f dνdμ. The key hypothesis is integrability (for signed f) or non-negativity (for unsigned f).
